title: Reuse and cleanup
current: A terminal item's lanes retire on the machine that holds them once each proves clean and landed; a preserved lane is named with its reason. A standalone landing and a deployment run's member close-out both retire the item's own lanes and then run the machine-wide merged-lane sweep; run close-out prints each preserved lane as a `Lane cleanup warning:` with the doctor repair. A hosted control plane settles runs where no lane lives, so lane creation at the `max_active_worktrees` cap runs the same sweep first and then refuses only for what remains, naming unmerged lanes to merge, landed lanes and finished deploy-run driver trees for `yoke watch doctor -- --only HC-worktree-health --fix`, and an open run's driver tree as in use.
